scope: editable source model/UI and actual current Workspace with source override; no user browser or storage mutation

tests.name: actual customer page installs one source-complete profile list without the split contacts list
customer details preserve original predictive time, actual actor, disposition, batch and guarded original-details entry
current source references route to business, personal snapshot and original native controls without new write eligibility
tampered or revoked exact source references never open a source
AI original details preserve the complete exact bridge reference
masked AI history is visible as pending source records without making a fake contact
failed source remains an explicit partial view while other source records are retained
query, source filter, detail and page state save the scope-bound navigation state and restore only matching scope
late AI read after a tenant switch cannot refresh or expose its old source rows
late AI read after leaving the customer page cannot reopen or refresh it
a successful asynchronous source load refreshes once and does not loop on init
source names and summary markup are rendered as text
actual Workspace read services use snapshot and preserve separate Cloud source capability
